authority.principle: Only essential state/action icons require exact approved artwork; selective images need a concrete information benefit; rubric-only actions remain fully expressed in rubrics without images.

tiers.ESSENTIAL: Precise recognizable image necessary for fast reading of a state or principal Mass moment. If absent, prioritize generating reviewed replacement.
tiers.SELECTIVE: Illustrate only where it adds meaning not already carried by the ribbon, text, rubrics or adjacent icon. No automatic generation.
tiers.RUBRIC_ONLY: The correct liturgical rubric/text is sufficient. Do not generate a picture to increase coverage.

rules: The Mass cue remains source-owned; neither the presence nor absence of artwork triggers an action, posture, movement or music event.
A rejected or repurposed donor is not an accurate illustration until the new subject is identified and approved.
The same information must have one visible owner: current position vs transient action, posture vs gesture, bell vs Schola.
Keep priest/faithful/server/deacon/thurifer actors separate. Never assign priest artwork to a minister action.
No automatically invented station during asynchronous or route-controlled priest movement.
A missing essential image becomes a generation candidate; a missing rubric-only image is intentionally complete.
User-approved visual style and faithful liturgical reference must precede generation; generated art is not production-approved.
No generic animation or attention badge solely to indicate progress through the Mass.
